title: Duo
program_note:
Much of my music is characterized by consonant sounds used in dissonant ways, or dissonant sounds used in consonant ways. Duo falls into the first category: consonant and familiar sounds—major and minor triads—are pitted against one another, sometimes within a single piano, other times across the two pianos. The result is a richly textured work featuring complex harmonies, in which the dividing line between old and new, familiar and unfamiliar, is meant to be blurred.

Duo was written between October, 1998 and June, 1999 for Erin Chung, who commissioned the work. She and Tomoko Kumagai premiered the work in 2000 in Mannheim, Germany.
